name: Sub-Ledger Reconciliation
brief: Detects drift between the customer sub-ledger and its G/L receivables control accounts.
description: For each G/L receivables control account, compares the summed remaining amount (LCY) of the open customer ledger entries against the account balance. Any non-zero delta is drift - a manual G/L posting, a reassigned posting group, a partial reversal. Read-only: the extension never posts or modifies data. Runs on demand from the Reconciliation Findings page or on a schedule through the Job Queue. Implemented as a pure, upgrade-safe extension with no changes to base objects.
